nodes.title: Geometric sums as sums of two squares

nodes.summary: For real $x$, let $B(x)$ be the number of natural numbers $m \le x$, including $m = 0$, that can be written as $m = a^2 + b^2$ with natural numbers $a$ and $b$. Then there is a constant $c_0 > 0$ such that $B(x)$ is asymptotically equivalent to $c_0 x / \sqrt{\log x}$ as $x \to \infty$.
nodes.title: Landau–Ramanujan theorem

nodes.summary: A positive natural number $n$ can be written as $n = a^2 - b^2$ with natural numbers $a$ and $b$ if and only if there is no natural number $k$ with $n = 4k + 2$.

nodes.summary: Let $d > 2$ be a natural number. Then $d = a^2 + b^2$ for some coprime positive natural numbers $a$ and $b$ if and only if there is a natural number $q$, all of whose prime factors are congruent to $1$ modulo $4$, such that $d = q$ or $d = 2q$.
